claim: T1059.001 rule (image/parent_image only, no command_line/mitre_technique/marker) produces zero false positives and zero false negatives against the 2 ground-truth-labeled T1059.001 events across the full 250000-event replay, confirmed as part of the current full 12-rule pipeline run.
proves: Shows the rule generalizes to the real ground truth using only structural process-lineage signal.
does_not_prove: Does not prove behavior against staff's 8 hidden mutations (not yet available); does not prove field-loss/rename robustness (not yet tested).
alternative_considered: Considered scoring success by verdict count alone (2 alerted); rejected in favor of explicit event_id set-equality check, since count matching does not prove the SAME two events matched.
disposition: Retained the set-comparison method as the standard for all subsequent rules.

does_not_prove: Does not prove behavior against staff's 8 hidden mutations or 12 hidden benign holdouts, which are not yet available.

claim: The 3 unresolved fixture collisions (P-DET-14/33/34) are provably unsolvable with any permitted signal: their (image, parent_image, event_code, command_family) fields are identical to real alert-case fixtures (P-DET-05/06/10/08 respectively); only the technique/case label differs.
